children: shares fell about 6% Friday after the software maker selected longtime executive Anil Chakravarthy to become its next chief executive.

Chakravarthy, currently responsible for Adobe's customer experience business and global field operations, will take over on Dec. 1. Shantanu Narayen, who has led the company for more than 18 years, will move into the executive chair role.

The leadership change arrives as Adobe works to adjust its business for the rapid adoption of artificial intelligence. The company has faced pressure from AI-focused competitors, while its shares were already down about 18% in 2026 before Friday's decline, according to Reuters.
Another leadership change is adding to investor attention. David Wadhwani, who oversees Adobe's creativity and productivity operations, is leaving the company, according to the source material.
The selloff suggests investors wanted a different leadership approach as Adobe confronts AI disruption and competitive pressure.

title: Adobe Stock Sinks After Company Names Insider as New CEO
